project.name: West Coast Hip-Hop Instrumental Uplifting Hook-Heavy

arrangement.notes: This arrangement features a clear intro, two verses, a hook emphasizing energetic and uplifting instrumentation, a bridge providing contrast, a final hook with intensified elements, and an outro.

event_markers.label: Intro Start
event_markers.reason: Beginning of the track with low energy drum pattern

event_markers.label: Hook Start
event_markers.reason: High energy hook with prominent melody

event_markers.label: Bridge Texture
event_markers.reason: Introduce FX for contrast and variation

event_markers.label: Final Hook Boost
event_markers.reason: Increase drum intensity for final hook climax

track_roles.bass: delivers the low-end and groove foundation
track_roles.chords: fills harmonic texture and rhythm support

sensei_drum.brief: Design drum patterns emphasizing groove and energy transitions, highlighting the hook sections with higher activity.

bass_generator.brief: Create bass lines that provide a deep, rhythmic foundation aligning with the groove and energy profile of the track, particularly hook-heavy parts.

harmony_generator.brief: Generate chord progressions supporting the uplifting mood, with rhythmically engaging voicings and changes over sections.

melody_generator.brief: Compose uplifting melodic hooks with high prominence in hook sections and reduced activity in verses and intro/outro.

ai_designer.brief: Oversee overall arrangement structure, ensuring energy flow and sectional transitions reflect a hook-heavy uplifting West Coast Hip-Hop instrumental.

presetor.brief: Apply presets suitable for West Coast Hip-Hop instrumental sounds, maintaining clarity and emphasis on hooks.

songgps.brief: Track and guide arrangement energy curve and sectional boundaries to ensure dynamics fit the uplifting hook-heavy profile.

ai_mixmaster.brief: Prepare unprocessed channel audio for mixing stages, ensuring balance and separation in stems reflecting arrangement priorities.
